title: Evolution of the Gas Mass Fraction of Progenitors to Today’s Massive Galaxies: ALMA Observations in the CANDELS GOODS-S Field
question: How does the gas mass fraction of likely progenitors of a z=0 galaxy of M*=1.5e11 Msun evolve over z=2-5, using ALMA dust continuum as a gas tracer?

data.bands: Band 6 (230 GHz, 1.3 mm) for z=4-5; Band 7 (345 GHz, 870 µm) for z=2-3

what.value: Stellar masses, redshifts, SFR, E(B-V), metallicity from CANDELS SED fits

evidence.quote: The redshifts and stellar mass estimates used in our analysis are from Santini et al. (2015).
We also use data on the size and morphology of the galaxies in the CANDELS GOODS-S catalog from van der Wel et al. 2012.
see da Cunha et al. (2013) for a discussion and quantification of this correction.

recipe.method: MEAM defines M*-z region of progenitors of z=0 log M*=11.2; 70 galaxies randomly chosen from CANDELS GOODS-S H-band catalog in four z bins
CLEAN natural-weight images; peak flux, or 2D Gaussian integrated flux for slightly extended sources; 5σ detection limit
stacked ALMA images of non-detected galaxies per bin; 3σ rms upper limits; random 4-galaxy substacks checked

recipe.goal: Derive gas masses and gas fractions
recipe.method: Mgas = L850/alpha850 with CMB correction; fgas = Mgas/(Mgas+M*)
assumptions: Td=25 K, beta=1.8, alpha_850 = 6.7e19 erg/s/Hz/Msun, CMB correction for 25 K

recipe.method: Modified blackbody SED to get minimum detectable SFR; gas-to-dust vs metallicity (Draine 2007; Remy-Ruyer) correction to z>=4 limits
assumptions: gas-phase Z as low as ~0.2 Zsun at z>=4 via mass-metallicity relation

recipe.goal: Fit evolution of fgas with cosmic time
recipe.method: linear fit of fgas vs cosmic time over z=3 to 0 including literature points

evidence.quote: We detect submm emission in 15 out of 20 galaxies in the z=2 sample, 11 out of 20 in the z=3 sample
The average gas mass fraction for the detected z = 2 galaxies is f gas = 0.55 ± 0.12
f gas = 0.62 ± 0.15 for the z = 3 sample

answer_key.quantity: Upper limit fgas z>=4 corrected for low metallicity

evidence.quote: the upper limit to the gas mass fraction of the z=4 and z=5 samples would increase to ∼ 0.66.

answer_key.quantity: Rate of fgas decrease with cosmic time

evidence.loc: 5.1 The gas mass fraction over cosmic time
evidence.quote: decreases at a constant rate of 0.043 ± 0.007 Gyr − 1 over a time interval of ∼ 11.5 Gyr.

not_stated_but_needed: Briggs robust and CLEAN threshold/masking, number of iterations
Method of stacking (weights, positions) of non-detected galaxies
Exact procedure and aperture for 2D Gaussian fits and noise measurement
How the 3σ upper limit flux was converted, rest-frame 850 µm k-correction details
Which MEAM stellar mass bounds per bin and how random selection was done
Bandpass/phase calibrator spelled consistently (J023+1636, J03344008 appear garbled)
Table 3 band/redshift labels inconsistent with text
missing_for_reproduction: Exact CMB correction implementation and SED k-correction
score_reason: Public data, Table of per-galaxy fluxes and simple conversion; imaging and stacking details are thin.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple flux-to-gas-mass recipe with numeric results in tables, though stacking and imaging details are missing.
